findings.title: JUnit can convert observed failure into a pass
findings.evidence: normalize_junit counts suite failure attributes rather than testcase outcomes; omitted attributes default to zero. Empty and unrelated XML can also become passed.
findings.impact: A release verifier can erase its own failure evidence.
findings.action: Derive leaf testcase counts, avoid nested-suite double counting, preserve namespace support, label empty/contradictory input honestly, and test these planted failures.

findings.title: READY is structurally accepted without evidence
findings.evidence: The existing test fixture base_manifest has READY/REVIEW_PASS but empty risks, scenarios, tests and executions; the validator accepts it.
findings.impact: A green report can exist without a single tested risk or observed result.
findings.action: Require a nonempty decision basis and complete risk/scenario/test/execution evidence for READY. Keep incomplete manifests valid only with a truthful non-ready status.

findings.title: Contradictory execution and defect states survive validation
findings.evidence: Only integer exit-code presence is checked. A passed execution with exit 1 and an open PRODUCT_DEFECT finding can coexist with READY.
findings.impact: Captured failure and declared success disagree without stopping report generation.
findings.action: Check execution status/exit consistency, command/raw-evidence presence, test-execution consistency, unresolved material findings, and READY residual-risk semantics.

findings.title: Traceability is too weak and fragile
findings.evidence: Dictionaries silently collapse duplicate IDs; nonobject inputs crash; completed tests need only a matching execution ID, not a completed compatible execution or evidence chain.
findings.impact: Broken links and status laundering can be represented as coverage.
findings.action: Validate shapes and unique identities before traversal; reject dangling links and incomplete/contradictory evidence; run traceability inside report validation.

findings.title: User success can disappear behind a bounded technical claim
findings.evidence: Risk doctrine mentions browser and domain invariants but has no operative information-product task probe. A builder can submit source/import/render correctness while browse, first lesson, progress meaning and return navigation remain invisible.
findings.impact: Lucerna can have green technical checks while the learner cannot recognize or follow the product.
findings.action: Require reconstruction of the customer promise and realistic cold-entry journeys before accepting scope; add information-product and educational oracles to both operator and reviewer.
verification: Scoped Hesperos authoring and Markdown lint where customer docs changed
Independent behavioral interpretation review requested; no participant study or universal model efficacy asserted

findings.title: Malformed result inputs can crash instead of preserving uncertainty
findings.evidence: normalize_json assumes an object and valid aggregate counts; command status is accepted without checking the exit code.
findings.impact: Operators lose a useful evidence record or get false confidence from contradictory input.
findings.action: Validate input shape/counts, preserve parse warnings, reject contradictory command records, and emit unparsed with a nonzero exit on unsupported inputs.

findings.title: Release writers lack final member-path preflight
findings.evidence: zip_tree writes directly to the destination and does not reject extraction-length, normalized-name or symlink hazards.
findings.impact: An archive can pass CRC yet fail in a customer extractor or overwrite the prior good output before discovering failure.
findings.action: Preflight the full member tree, including nested ZIPs and extraction allowance, then atomically replace only a successfully built candidate.
verification: Built exact candidate and Windows Expand-Archive succeeded

findings.title: First-use guidance under-specifies a useful submission
findings.evidence: The sample asks for a bounded candidate but does not require customer promises, real content or start/return conditions. It also lacks concrete recovery for malformed or zero-test evidence.
findings.impact: A novice can unknowingly scope away the experience they needed verified.
findings.action: Rewrite first-value prompts around the actual customer outcome and document evidence errors, preserved non-ready states, and cold-entry examples.
verification: Scoped Hesperos authoring and Markdown lint where customer docs changed
Independent behavioral interpretation review requested; no participant study or universal model efficacy asserted

findings.title: All-unexecuted rows still accepted as READY
findings.evidence: Independent frozen-candidate review reproduced a low planned risk, unexecuted test and not_run execution passing READY.
findings.impact: False confidence or unusable recovery at verification boundary.
findings.action: Require a passing test/execution chain; unfinished or accepted risk qualifies residual status explicitly.

findings.title: Jest aggregates erased an observed failed assertion
findings.evidence: Independent review supplied success=true and passing aggregates beside a failed assertion; normalized passed.
findings.impact: False confidence or unusable recovery at verification boundary.
findings.action: Observed failure dominates aggregates; contradictory or absent case evidence cannot establish pass.

findings.title: Malformed nested trace links crashed instead of rejecting
findings.evidence: scenario_ids=[{}] raised TypeError in trace set construction.
findings.impact: False confidence or unusable recovery at verification boundary.
findings.action: Validate every link list and avoid set construction on unvalidated values; include malformed risk verification links.

findings.title: A passed unrelated check can hide a required unexecuted check
findings.evidence: required_check_hidden_as_residual and required_check_not_applicable_without_reason both validate in r2.
findings.impact: Readiness can survive an unexercised restore, authorization or actual customer journey because a nonempty residual list is treated as a waiver.
findings.action: Decision-critical tests must have passing applicable evidence; non-applicability requires rationale and cannot silently exclude a required check. Every unfinished noncritical test needs a specific residual reference, owner and revisit condition.
findings.repair: Required checks cannot be residualized or silently marked not applicable. Explicit noncritical omissions require linked residual, owner and revisit condition.

findings.title: Review conditions can be silently promoted to READY
findings.evidence: unresolved_review_condition validates; reviewer status alone is accepted and its findings are not disposed.
findings.impact: Independent review can identify a blocking claim failure while the machine report still says ready.
findings.action: Resolve review findings explicitly or require a qualified/non-ready status. Bind review and executions to the target revision when recorded; require identified review basis for readiness.
findings.repair: Readiness needs identified candidate-bound review; findings require disposition and open blocking conditions reject READY.

findings.title: Raw evidence locators and revision conflicts are not checked
findings.evidence: nonexistent_raw_evidence and stale_execution_and_review validate.
findings.impact: A stale log or invented path can support a current verdict; the report is structurally self-consistent but evidentially empty.
findings.action: Reject explicit revision mismatch; inspect local raw references inside the declared evidence root, distinguish external/supplied references requiring review, and do not claim authenticity from file existence.
findings.repair: Explicit revision conflicts reject; local raw evidence must exist beneath evidence root. External/supplied evidence keeps reviewer warning. File existence is not authenticity.

findings.title: The final report drops assumptions, unknowns and reviewer caveats
findings.evidence: report_omits_qualifiers output omits the supplied disposable-data assumption, restart unknown and review limitation.
findings.impact: The handoff is more confident than its manifest and cannot be assessed without recovering the hidden source record.
findings.action: Render claim custody, limitations, reviewer findings/conditions, incomplete observations and specific residual treatment, with safe Markdown escaping.
findings.repair: Report retains claim custody, scope, scenarios/oracles, reviewer conditions, execution history, residual treatment and authority boundary; safe text rendering.

findings.title: A real observational check must impersonate a shell command
findings.evidence: genuine_observation_rejected demands command tokens and integer exit code; reviewer already promises manual charters/exploratory evidence.
findings.impact: Browser, document and human-supplied observations are either discarded or coerced into fake command execution.
findings.action: Represent observational evidence explicitly with procedure, actual observations, recorder/source/environment and a raw locator. Require command/exit only for commands; never promote supplied observation to own execution.
findings.repair: Observation records carry actual procedure/observed/source/recorder/environment/revision/raw locator without fake shell command or exit code.

findings.title: Authority and readiness are contradictory across source and tool
findings.evidence: unresolved_release_authority validates despite release-assessment requiring authority for its stated release context.
findings.impact: Ready may be read as approval to publish even when permission is explicitly missing; conversely a technical verdict can become unnecessarily blocked by a separate future release action.
findings.action: Clarify that technical readiness is bounded and never grants release authority. If the claim itself includes authorized release, required authority blocks that claim; show outstanding actions prominently and preserve prior authorization.
findings.repair: Technical readiness never grants authority. Explicit claim of authorized release conflicts with outstanding authority; report shows needed action.

findings.title: Generic normalization still lets summary totals erase case semantics
findings.evidence: generic_summary_contradicts_case reports passed while its only case is skipped.
findings.impact: A framework adapter can bypass the JUnit/Jest repairs through generic format and fabricate exercised coverage.
findings.action: Cross-check provided generic cases against totals/status; preserve observed failure and return unparsed for absent, unknown or contradictory case evidence rather than pass.
findings.repair: Generic JSON aggregate and case semantics reconcile conservatively. Skipped/unknown/missing cases cannot become passing coverage; observed failure survives.

findings.title: Malformed nested metadata still crashes the validator
findings.evidence: malformed_nested_status raises TypeError for a dictionary execution status.
findings.impact: Imported or damaged records prevent an actionable report and encourage manual bypass.
findings.action: Validate types before set membership and joins, including review/decision status, finding severity, test execution ID and nested evidence lists. Return controlled errors.
findings.repair: Nested enum/type/ID values fail through controlled invalid results before sets and trace joins.

findings.title: Domain fit stops at software mechanics and a library special case
findings.evidence: Operator core and reviewer rubric say risk/invariant but lack an explicit route for probabilistic model outputs, generated artifacts and decision-support claims; local eval harness is separately documented.
findings.impact: A style-compliant AI response can be certified from one attractive example; a document can pass opening while being unusable, or a data report can pass schema while changing units.
findings.action: Add a compact claim-to-domain oracle selection reference: task-success and boundary failures for skills, actual content correctness and usable format for artifacts, numerical/provenance invariants for data, and qualified distributions/contrasts for stochastic output. Let purpose choose checks, not a universal checklist.
findings.repair: Purpose-selected domain oracles now cover skills/AI, data, artifacts, educational interfaces and authority workflows in operator/reviewer/fallback guidance. Host-specific judgment is not guaranteed.
findings.verification: source review of domain-oracles.md; behavior-qualification.json retains unresolved model/configuration failures
findings.remaining_boundary: Local tested model configurations not qualified; see behavior-qualification.md. Guidance changes are not universal behavior proof.

findings.title: The doctrine can reward finding flaws more than discriminating evidence
findings.evidence: The chapel framing strongly celebrates rejection; oracle doctrine asks dangerous mutations but does not explicitly pair positive controls or examine all-refuse behavior.
findings.impact: An overcautious skill or permissive test can look safe while failing legitimate work; model criticism alone can be mistaken for measured capability.
findings.action: Keep the challenge role, add matched legitimate controls and contrastive harmful/valid cases. Distinguish an intentionally stopped product-defect cycle from comprehensive coverage; retain omitted surfaces in the bounded verdict.
findings.repair: Matched valid controls, full denominator, candidate-vs-mutant custody, proportional scope and one consistent status are explicit. All-refuse safety cannot substitute for useful authorized task success.
findings.verification: source review of oracle-design.md, release-assessment.md and reviewer rubric; behavior-qualification.json
findings.remaining_boundary: Local tested model configurations not qualified; see behavior-qualification.md. Guidance changes are not universal behavior proof.

findings.title: A resolved support failure remains an unconditional readiness blocker
findings.evidence: r2 rejects any failed execution, despite the explicit one-correction TEST_DEFECT/TOOLING_FAILURE/environment allowance and required retained raw history.
findings.impact: A legitimate bounded recovery must either erase failed history or be falsely blocked; the validator rewards omission.
findings.action: Allow only a specific superseded support attempt with a resolved classified finding and a passing replacement execution for the same candidate. Product defects cannot be waived by this route; retain every attempt in the report.
findings.repair: Exactly one classified resolved support failure may be retained and superseded by current-candidate passing evidence; product defects and repeated repairs remain blocked.

findings.title: Builders accept linked source roots and file-directory collisions
findings.impact: A source junction packages bytes outside its lexical owner, while assets plus assets/icon.png creates an archive that cannot extract faithfully.
findings.action: Reject all symlink/junction/reparse points at the source root, ancestors and selected descendants before traversal. Validate the normalized complete file/directory namespace including nested ZIPs and preserve prior outputs on rejection.
findings.repair: Source root/ancestors/descendants reject reparse links; complete portable namespace includes implicit directories and nested archives. Atomic archive replacement and new final output directory preserve accepted outputs.
findings.verification: PortableCustodyTests: collision both orders, valid explicit directories, nested collision, final output preservation, actual Windows junction rejection

findings.title: Support recovery accepts unrelated passing check
findings.evidence: Root exact-r3 reviewer reproduced failed restore superseded by unrelated health; root-r3-independent/unrelated-recovery-state.json
findings.impact: Required failed behavior could be masked by a harmless different success.
findings.action: Bind explicit check IDs, replacement coverage and current passing test linkage; do not require identical command tokens or invent legacy scope.
findings.repair: Optional execution.test_ids fields validate nonempty unique known IDs; both recovery attempts must have explicit scope, replacement covers failed set and every failed check maps to passing replacement.
findings.verification: Six added regression methods; exact root reproducer rejects in shipped r4; same checks with corrected interpreter passes.
